interface.reset: None in original interface; no reset added

semantics.sampling: All sequential logic uses positive edge of clk, per original problem.
semantics.equation: After rising edge n, anyedge[b] = sampled_in[n][b] XOR sampled_in[n-1][b].
semantics.latency: Registered indication for the cycle following the edge that samples a changed input; no extra output pipeline.
semantics.between_edges: Output holds even when input changes.
semantics.initialization: Original specifies no initial value or reset; history and output are uninitialized. First sampled comparison can be unknown.

numeric.operation: Eight independent one-bit change comparisons; no arithmetic, signedness, rounding, or overflow.

verification.oracle: Compare each sampled bit against independently stored prior sample using four-state equality/inequality.
verification.phases: Drive away from rising edge, compare after NBA updates, verify hold between edges.
coverage: exhaustive ordered pairs of known 8-bit samples

specification_ambiguities.evidence: No reset port or initialization requirement is present.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not add initialization; require known functional comparisons after history is sampled.
